reviewer: /root/followup_live_audit: separate AI collection reviewer in the same orchestration
scope: Collection integrity, frozen material delivery, independently computed apparatus references, model/usage/cost accounting and provenance. No participant semantic coding.
limits: This is a read-only retrospective AI audit of retained local provider records in the same orchestration. It is not direct provider billing reconciliation, independent external investigation, or human validation.
Live designation and successful provider responses support actual API collection; the audit cannot cryptographically attest remote provider execution beyond the retained export and source provenance.

Configured rates charge all input tokens at USD 0.10/million and output at USD 0.40/million. Cached input usage is retained; the configured calculation deliberately ignores any cache discount and is not an invoice.

No participant whole-answer semantic coding, explanation consistency judgement, factual explanation accuracy, assessor calibration, coder output, or calibration gold is assessed here. Canonical JSON field counts are separate.

Collection rows attach derived score fields to unchanged raw session records; row/session identity omits only that added score field. Source plan and retained plan are semantically identical but have different JSON serialization bytes. The retained plan byte hash, not the author source serialization hash, matches the recorded execution provenance.

The frozen protocol contains prospective not-started execution fields. Actual completion is evidenced by provenance, attempts, session files, segments, progress, and pipeline collection status; the frozen protocol was not retrospectively rewritten.
The export ZIP checksum and source-commit identity are verified locally. The restore receipt digest identifies an earlier retained artifact and is not the checksum of the export ZIP.

Eight purposive AI-authored fictional task instances, one fixed model and one repeat permit finite collection and resource conclusions only. Shared donors and source structure make 120 recipients dependent; availability cause remains confounded with task-domain wording.

Summed provider/session durations are accumulated time across concurrent calls and include different scopes. The one collection segment elapsed time is wall-clock collection time; annotation and analysis are excluded.

identity_normalisation.session_files: Exclude only the derived score field added to raw collection rows; retain every raw collection field.
identity_normalisation.frozen_plan: Source and retained plan compare as parsed JSON; retained plan byte hash matches execution provenance.
identity_normalisation.reasoner_prompt: Remove only the declared computed decision field and canonicalise JSON packet formatting for between-reasoner prompt comparison.
